cc:Work.dc:title: transient-transport-time convergence
cc:Work.dc:description: transient-transport-time; all 5 measured levels; fixed final-four diagnostic window. Native UFL P2/r16 locals; P1 trace on eight face segments; fixed spatial operator; backward Euler. Fixed spatial operator; all five backward-Euler steps; capacity=diffusion=1, beta=(0.25,-0.5), reaction=0.5. Analytical physical concentration error; temporal approximation with fixed local/global spaces. Record examples/results/tutorial-methods/transient-native-study.json; SHA256 23bd55c72ff05a7ac18915a520c04e2043c31aabb626942a79c0de709e22d502. First-order backward Euler time approximation against an analytical concentration; independently checked norm quadrature and refined classical reference.
